original: Thus, the initial act of Yahweh was the revelation of Himself, as He manifested His presence. While this manifestation represents God and is indeed God, it does not encompass the entirety of God. It marks only the outset of a grand narrative. It is this manifestation that will be the agent in which God will create everything else. It is crucial to understand that this is a manifestation of God and not an object created by God. “His invisible attributes are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even His eternal power and Godhead.”- Romans 1:20. The manifestation of God reveals both the Godhead and His power, allowing them to be perceived, whereas without it, God would remain invisible, as it is one of His attributes.
